what_happened: The ego was creeping at about 1 m/s in stopped traffic, angled slightly right of its lane (3.4 m from the recorded path). It kept rolling until its front reached the rear-right corner of actor 24, which was queued just ahead in the same lane, and only slowed to 0.4 m/s at contact.

On an open highway with the nearest lead 43–60 m ahead, the ego braked steadily from 15.7 to 6.6 m/s for no visible reason and ended up about 20 m behind where the human was at that time. Vehicle 28, a replayed car that was following behind, couldn't react, so it caught up and overlapped the ego's rear/right side as the ego also drifted slightly left. The run flags this as a front collision, but the map shows a replayed actor driving into a car that had slowed down unexpectedly, not the ego hitting something ahead. Either the unexplained braking (maybe triggered by a bright smear on the road in the camera view) or the follower not reacting could be blamed.

The ego was going straight on an open highway lane with nothing ahead, but it kept slowing (9.6 to 7.7 m/s) and fell about 24 m behind where the human car was at that point in the recording. Actor 24, a replayed car overtaking on the right, then merged into the gap where the human car had left room, cut across the ego's front-right corner and was scored as a front collision (the ego was also rear-ended at some point).
